messages:
lina_devex: Heads-up: Support flagged a hosted customer with a big spike in 'unattributed' quota after upgrading to py-sdk v1.10.0. They run under gunicorn and see sampler traffic with no route headers.
sam_engineering: thanks. likely the same pre-fork race we've seen before: background sampler starts before per-route headers are attached. Can repro with gevent workers.
nate_go: Do Go/TS SDKs do background work at init? We should check if this is cross-lang.
rachel_ts: TS starts nothing at import. Go starts flusher lazily. This looks Python-only.
jenna_sre: Ops plan: add server-side fallback mapping missing headers to tenant-unrouted (emit metric quota.unrouted) so customers don't get charged incorrectly while clients patch. I'll canary that.
sam_engineering: Client fix: lazy-start sampler on first outbound call, and log a one-time warning if we detect a pre-fork environment. Provide env RW_PREFORK_ALLOW to opt-in. Simple patch, tests included.
lina_devex: Can we also surface a console tile showing top endpoints with missing headers for CS? That'll speed triage.
rachel_ts: I'll file a Console ticket and wire it to the support view with a link to upgrade notes.
observability-bot: [metric] quota.unrouted +1 (canary)
sam_engineering: PR opened: py-sdk #5120, cutting 1.10.1-rc with lazy-start and changelog.
jenna_sre: deploy started: routing-service/canary -> v2.16.0 at 2025-11-03T11:00:00Z
lina_devex: Thanks all. I'll post an announcement when 1.10.1 is promoted and schedule follow-up for removing server fallback after 14 days if metric <0.01%.
